item.title: Gunsmoke - Outlaw's Woman
item.description: Matt is surprised to see that the fleeing train robber he shot is a woman.

item.title: The Waltons - The Roots
item.description: An itinerant worker and his young son stay with the Waltons, causing the son to want his father to give up life on the road

item.title: Hawaii Five-O - Savage Sunday
item.description: McGarrett must interrupt his Sunday to deal with both terrorists and politics when a revolutionary group steal guns from a barracks for their overseas cause.

item.title: Matlock - Heist, The (Part 1)
item.description: Matlock and Jerri head out to the beach with Billy and Cliff as Cliff prepares for an upcoming triathlon. Matlock runs into retired F.B.I. agent Ed Wingate, who is investigating a case. When one of the people Wingate is investigating is found dead, Matlock agrees to defend his old friend.

item.title: Perry Mason - The Case of the Renegade Refugee
item.description: A journalist is murdered while tracking an ex-Nazi war criminal who may be posing as an executive at a company called Space Associates, Ltd.

item.title: Leave It to Beaver - The Merchant Marine
item.description: Ward comes down hard on Wally after he comes home two hours late, this fuels June and Ward's suspicions that Wally is contemplating joining the Merchant Marines. June had discovered some pamphlets hidden in his dresser drawer. However, little does anyone know, Wally has been getting the information for Lumpy who's seriously thinking of joining.

item.title: Leave It to Beaver - Beaver's Typewriter
item.description: Seeing an ad for typewriters on sale, Beaver talks his parents into letting him get one as long as he learns how to use it. However, Beaver discovers learning to type is not as easy as it looks and soon finds himself making a deal with the shady Eddie Haskell.

item.title: Toon In With Me - Throwback Thursday: 1971
Adam-12 - Log 95: Purse Snatcher
item.description: Reed and Malloy have to think outside the box to capture an intelligent yet neglected teenage purse snatcher. Their efforts to talk sense into him before he commits a much more serious crime prove to be futile.

item.title: Adam-12 - Log 35: Easy Bare Rider
item.description: Malloy and Reed investigate the mysterious source behind a boy's suspicious spending spree, wield a blanket instead of gun during a disrobed driver's DUI arrest and bust up a car parts theft ring.
